title: Administrative Assistant
description:
ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT (12 MONTH CONTRACT)
MACCLESFIELD, CHESHIRE
UP TO 26,500 + EXCELLENT BENEFITS
POSSIBLE OPPORTUNITY TO GO PERMANENT

THE OPPORTUNITY:

We're partnering with a well-established and growing business in Macclesfield that is looking to recruit an organised and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to join its Accounts Team on a 12-month fixed term contract.

The successful candidate will provide essential administrative support to the Accounts Team, assisting with data entry, maintaining accurate records, processing documentation and handling customer queries. You'll work closely with colleagues across the business to ensure information is processed accurately and day-to-day administrative tasks are completed efficiently.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong office administration, data entry or customer service experience who is looking to develop their skills within an accounts environment. Previous accounting experience is not essential, making this an ideal opportunity for an experienced Administrator looking for a new challenge.

THE ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT ROLE:
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the Accounts Team, ensuring tasks are completed accurately and within deadlines
- Processing, uploading and updating customer information, invoices and documentation onto internal systems
- Carrying out regular data entry tasks, ensuring records are accurate, complete and up to date
- Maintaining and organising electronic records, spreadsheets and customer documentation
- Handling incoming telephone calls and emails, responding to queries and directing enquiries to the appropriate departments
- Liaising with internal teams and external customers to obtain missing information and resolve administrative queries
- Preparing reports, spreadsheets and supporting documentation as required
- Checking information for accuracy, identifying discrepancies and ensuring corrections are made promptly
- Assisting with the administration of customer accounts, including updating records and processing relevant paperwork
- Supporting the Credit Control and wider Accounts Team with general administrative duties
- Working towards departmental KPIs and ensuring administrative deadlines and service standards are consistently achieved
- Supporting improvements to existing administrative processes and procedures
- Undertaking additional office administration duties as required

THE PERSON:
- Previous experience within an Administrative Assistant, Office Administrator, Accounts Administrator, Data Entry Administrator, Customer Service Administrator or similar role
- Experience working within a busy office or administrative environment is essential
- Strong administrative and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook
- Previous experience with data entry, document processing and maintaining accurate records
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when handling information
- Confident communicating with customers and colleagues via telephone and email
- Comfortable learning new computer systems and following established administrative processes
- Previous experience working within an Accounts or Finance Team would be advantageous but is not essential
- Available to commit to a 12-month fixed term contract

TO APPLY:

Please send your CV for the Administrative Assistant role via the advert for immediate consideration.

By sending an application or applying for a job, you consent to your personal data being processed and stored by Get Recruited (UK) Ltd in accordance with our Cookie & Privacy Policy (available in the footer on our website). Get Recruited (UK) Ltd acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and as an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. We are an equal opportunities employer and we never charge candidates a fee for our services.

title: Car Leasing Sales Advisor
description:
CAR LEASING SALES ADVISOR
MACCLESFIELD (office based only)
25, 000 - 26, 000pa doe + UNCAPPED COMMS

Mon to Fri 8.30am - 5.30pm

Our client is seeking a self motivated Car Leasing Sales Advisor with a solid proven background in sales - this role is telephone based and involves following up warm leads (no cold calling).

We want to hear from individuals who are truly focused on the ote they can earn - the average sales teams earnings are sitting around 70 - 80k, with top earners coming in around 100k. This is realistic and can be proven at interview to reassure you these figures are realistic and being achieved by the team.

Car Leasing Sales Advisor Duties
- Managing your own pipeline of customers, acting upon warm leads
- Building rapport with customers and listening to their needs and requirements
- Sourcing a product to suit their needs, making suggestions and offering alternatives that they may not have considered
-Keeping up to date with product knowledge and changes within the industry
- Ensuring you stay in contact with previous customers to assist them with renewals

Car Leasing Sales Advisor Requirements
- A solid background in sales, you must be confident speaking to customers over the telephone
- Experience in car sales or car leasing is essential
- You must live within a sensible commuting distance of Macclesfield - if you live outside of Macclesfield then own transport is needed due to location

To apply for the Car Leasing Sales Advisor role please send your Cv for a response back in 72 hours.

title: HR Administrator
description:
Your new company
You'll be joining an established organisation based near Wilmslow on a 12-month fixed-term contract. Working within a supportive HR function, you'll play an important role in providing a smooth and professional HR service to employees and managers across the business.
Your new role
As HR Administrator, you'll support employees throughout the full employee life cycle, combining HR administration with first-line advice and guidance.
- Managing onboarding, employee changes, promotions, transfers, salary changes and leaver processes
- Processing and maintaining employee information through Workday
- Providing first-line guidance to employees and managers on HR policies, processes and systems
- Supporting payroll changes and employee benefits administration
- Coordinating annual HR activities, including salary reviews, long-service awards and wider people initiatives
- Maintaining accurate and confidential employee records
- Producing HR data and supporting internal audits
- Getting involved in HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives

What you'll need to succeed
You'll need to have strong previous experience working within HR and be confident managing a varied workload in a busy environment.
- Good working knowledge of UK employment law
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Experience using HR systems, ideally Workday or a similar HRIS
- Good Microsoft Office skills
- The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately

What you'll get in return
You'll receive an excellent salary of 32,000 as well as hybrid working, with three days per week on-site, you'll have access to a strong benefits package, including:
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Employer pension contribution starting at 5%
- Private medical cover, including options for your partner/family
- Company-paid secure on-site parking
- Employee recognition, referral and company events

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV.
